rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: COCbaden
Exhibition name: Doctor Dick
rows.Bloom: Orange-pink. Mild fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 5". Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Notes: Named for the noted Scots rosarian Archie Dick (1915-1984).
